intro_notes: NOTE: The Artificial Intelligence (AI) merit badge has no merit badge pamphlet. Instead, it has been designed for you to interact with the Scoutly chatbot on your learning journey as you work through the requirements. Scoutly can be found on the bottom right of your browser at https://scouting.org. If you have a question about a requirement, ask Scoutly! Hint: try asking Scoutly to Explain the "xxx" activity for requirement "yy" of the AI merit badge. This does not replace the requirement to identify and work with a counselor to complete the badge. Additional educational resources are available on our Counselor Information Page.

requirements.lead_text: Key Concepts. Define the following terms and share the meaning of each with your counselor: artificial intelligence (AI), artificial intelligence agents, automation, basic programming, bots, data, databases, digital workers, general AI, machine learning (ML), narrow AI, superintelligent AI, tasks, triggers, workflows, and variables.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 1): Define the following terms and share the meaning of each with your counselor: artificial intelligence (AI), artificial intelligence agents, automation, basic programming, bots, data, databases, digital workers, general AI, machine learning (ML), narrow AI, superintelligent AI, tasks, triggers, workflows, and variables.
Field Verification Standard: Apply Artificial Intelligence Requirement 1 procedures using verifiable measurements, clear terminology, and the BSA EDGE method.
Safety & Policy Alignment: Follow the BSA Guide to Safe Scouting, Two-Deep Leadership, and the Buddy System during all Artificial Intelligence Req 1 activities.
Counselor Conference Readiness: Record concrete observations, examples, and sketches in your Artificial Intelligence Workbook before requesting Requirement 1 sign-off.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 1): Review the official Artificial Intelligence requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Key Concepts. Define the following terms and share.
Execute & Document: Perform the key task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Artificial Intelligence Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.

requirements.lead_text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Basics. Do the following and share what you learned with your counselor:
requirements.req_text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Basics. Do the following and share what you learned with your counselor: (a) Identify 10 examples of how AI is currently used in everyday life. (b) Identify five examples of how AI is currently used in the workplace. (c) Identify five examples of how AI can be used at school or in support of your education. (d) Meet with your counselor and play 10 rounds of the "AI or Not?" game to determine if the presented scenario utilizes AI. Discuss your answers. (e) Create a timeline with five key milestones in the development of artificial intelligence.

requirements.lead_text: Practical Application. Do ONE of the following:
requirements.req_text: Practical Application. Do ONE of the following: (a) With your counselor's approval, choose an artificial intelligence project based on your personal interest or a community need. Develop a plan outlining the project's objectives, data requirements, and potential ethical considerations. Implement the project utilizing appropriate artificial intelligence tools, languages, or platforms. Share your project with your counselor. Discuss the steps you followed to create the project and your experience during the process. (b) With your counselor's approval, design a short lesson plan on AI and teach it to your patrol or a group of Scouts. The lesson should include an AI-generated age-appropriate explanation of AI, examples of how AI is used in both everyday life as well as in the workplace, and an interactive demonstration of how Scouts could utilize AI to assist them with a school assignment, Scouting activity, or rank advancement. Share information on the development process and teaching experience with your counselor.
